current_events: The Dutch military police and coast guard rescue 38 people from a rubber boat adrift off the coast of Breskens, Zeeland, and detain two people on suspicion of people smuggling
Human trafficking in the Netherlands

Poland's ambassador to Romania, Paweł Soloch, and Poland's ambassador to China, Jakub Kumoch, resign from their positions in protest of the suspension of Polish Constitutional Tribunal president Bogdan Święczkowski
Suspension of Bogdan Święczkowski
Polish Constitutional Tribunal crisis
Polish constitutional crisis, China–Poland relations, Poland–Romania relations

Metropolitan Police arrest 139 people outside the United States embassy in London, United Kingdom, during a protest supporting Palestine Action, which is designated as a proscribed terrorist organisation
Gaza war protests in the United Kingdom

Madagascar's justice ministry announces dismantling 13 Chinese-run scam centers since August, linked to 148 Chinese nationals who had previously operated scam centers in Cambodia, and who might have been involved in trafficking Africans to commit fraud. The 148 Chinese are extradited to China
Trafficking of Chinese nationals to scam centers abroad, Human trafficking in Madagascar
Protests are held across France for the third consecutive weekend

Protests are held in 34 cities of Germany against the high cost of livings and wars. Clashes erupts in Frankfurt, Berlin, Cologne and Hamburg. In Frankfurt, shops are looted, with several people being arrested
Riots erupt in Zurich and Basel, Switzerland, with fires reported
Clashes erupt in The Hague, Netherlands, in a youth-led protest, with 34 people arrested

In figure skating, France's Kevin Aymoz wins the men's singles title at Skate Canada in Kelowna, British Columbia, overtaking Japan's Rio Nakata and becoming the second-oldest men's Grand Prix champion at age 29
2026 Skate Canada International
2026–27 ISU Grand Prix of Figure Skating
In thoroughbred horse racing, thoroughbred racehorse Sovereignty wins the Breeders' Cup classic at the Keeneland racetrack in Lexington, Kentucky, U.S
The 2026 Summer Youth Olympics opens in Dakar, Senegal, marking the first IOC event in Africa
In women's basketball, the Golden State Valkyries defeat the Atlanta Dream 68–63 in game seven to win their first WNBA championship. Gabby Williams is named MVP
